chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Ziyād, from Khalīl al-ʿAbdī, from Ziyād ibn ʿĪsā, from ʿAlī ibn Ḥanẓalah, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام said: “In the Book of ʿAlī عليه السلام: one qāmah is one cubit, and two qāmahs are two cubits.”

key_terms.ذِرَاعٌ: a cubit; a unit of length
key_terms.كِتَابِ عَلِيٍّ: the written compilation attributed to Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام containing legal teachings
key_terms.ٱلْقَامَةُ: a measured unit used in determining prayer-related rulings
key_terms.ٱلْقَامَتَانِ: two qāmahs, meaning a doubled measure

ai.seo_question: What does the Book of ʿAlī عليه السلام say about the measure of one qāmah and two qāmahs?
ai.summary: This hadith transmits a ruling preserved in the Book of ʿAlī عليه السلام concerning the measurement of qāmah. It defines one qāmah as one cubit and two qāmahs as two cubits, which is relevant to legal discussions on prayer-related measurements and timings.
